title: Admitted tiered RossFast serial hydrologic trajectory validation
purpose: Validate temporal composition of the canonically admitted F-ROSS22 tiered RossFast solver over multi-interval unsaturated trajectories without widening the admitted production envelope.

claim_boundary.what_is_extended: temporal composition and trajectory accumulation only

domain.materials: all 36 admitted B01..B18 and O01..O18 materials
domain.profile_construction: Historical Gate-D log10(-h) gradient with N241 table-coordinate fraction clamped to [0.2,0.8].

forcing_policies.ZERO_SHARED: identical q_top=0 and q_bottom_up=0 for both routes; provably inside the admitted state-local flux envelope whenever K>0
forcing_policies.NOMINAL_SHARED: identical paired forcing each interval, q_top=0.01*sqrt(Ktop_ref*Ktop_ross) and q_bottom_up=-0.004*sqrt(Kbottom_ref*Kbottom_ross); proceed only while the common flux is independently inside both routes' unchanged state-local production envelopes

domain.route_pairing: Both routes start from exactly the same initial state. At every interval they receive exactly the same boundary fluxes. Each route advances from its own previous terminal state.

metrics: per-interval route validity and first failure interval/reason
per-interval RossFast final K2/K4/K8 tier and temporal indicator
cumulative external water transfer and storage closure
paired head infinity/RMS difference at intervals 1,2,4,8,16,32
paired theta infinity/RMS difference at intervals 1,2,4,8,16,32
paired common-forcing envelope loss, if any
analysis_rules: Do not use single-interval P2E10 thresholds as admission gates for serial trajectories.
Separate RossFast route failure, Reference failure, paired forcing-envelope loss, and accumulated route divergence.
A Reference failure does not count as a RossFast failure.
Any RossFast failure on an otherwise admitted serial state/forcing pair is a negative result and must be reported.
Do not generalize beyond the exact homogeneous 16x10cm fixed-flux production envelope.
next_permitted_action: IMPLEMENT_AND_MEASURE: build only the diagnostic serial-trajectory harness for this frozen contract, run all 216 trajectories, persist the complete result, then analyze and close.
